title: Lexicon
description: Stems and the properties that cannot be derived from their spelling.

final_voicing.description: Stem-final p/c/t/k voices before a vowel-initial suffix. Required on any stem ending in one of those four; see the semantic checks.

vowel_deletion.description: The last stem vowel drops before a vowel-initial suffix: burun -> burnu.

harmony_class.description: Only on disharmonic loans, where suffix backness does not follow the last stem vowel.

frequency_band.description: Corpus frequency band. Absent until a real list is loaded; never guessed.

review.description: Anything a native speaker should confirm. Never a placeholder for a guess.
